candidate.version_description: Originally recorded by the Coon Creek Sisters, this song has been re-recorded many times, including by Hazel Dickens and Alice Gerrard. A great version to learn it is performed by the Augusta Bluegrass Women, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HXF2SHvDkPc.
